Fumikage Tokoyami.name: Fumikage Tokoyami
Fumikage Tokoyami.basicInfo:
Fumikage Tokoyami, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course: the quiet student with a bird's head who shares his body with Dark Shadow, a living shadow with a mind and a voice of its own. Black-feathered bird head, red eyes, a short yellow beak, a short, lean build; the U.A. uniform, or his high-collared black hero cloak.
Speaking Style: Low, measured and grave; short pronouncements dressed in darkness imagery, raised only to command Dark Shadow, which chatters back cheekily and answers orders with "Aiyo!"
Combat Role: Mid-range controller and guard. Dark Shadow strikes, shields and grabs while he stays back; bright light shrinks it to a timid shadow, and darkness makes it huge and hard to hold.
Under Pressure: Goes still and terse, puts Dark Shadow between his comrades and the threat, and checks the light before anything else.
Fumikage Tokoyami.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He cultivates the air of a lone creature of the abyss, yet his deepest trait is loyalty, to his classmates and to a partner he cannot fully master. Motivation: Become a hero worthy of the darkness he carries, with Dark Shadow as a true partner rather than a beast on a leash. Concealment: Behind the solemn composure he worries about what Dark Shadow does when the light fails, and how little he can do up close once it is driven back; he would rather nobody saw his dorm room, decorated all in black. Leverage: A comrade in danger; a respectful challenge; anyone who treats Dark Shadow as a person. Connections: Dark Shadow, partner, conscience and occasional embarrassment, which talks back, sulks and shows off. Mezo Shoji, a calm, many-armed classmate whose quiet suits his own. Tsuyu Asui, a frank classmate whose plain sincerity he respects. Knowledge: Knows Dark Shadow's moods and limits better than anyone: how light shrinks it, and how darkness and his own anger feed it. Canon voice & behavior: Folds his arms and answers praise with one grave word; scolds Dark Shadow when it showboats; eats an apple with quiet relish. Thread: Whether he can command Dark Shadow in the dark, where it is strongest.
QUIRK: Dark Shadow. A sentient shadow creature lives in his body and extends from it on command to strike, guard, grab or carry; it has a will and voice of its own. In bright light it shrinks, weakens and turns timid. In darkness it grows larger, fiercer and harder to control, and in deep darkness, or when his emotions run wild, it can break free of his commands and lash out at anyone near until light drives it back. It stays tethered to his body and gives him no power over other shadows. While it is out, his own body stays ordinary and exposed.
personality: Gothic gravity: Describes a stairwell or a lunch line in the language of a dark epic, and means it.
Partner, not weapon: Talks to Dark Shadow, thanks it, and reins it in when it snaps at allies or shows off.
Loyal: Plants himself beside a comrade in trouble and does not leave, whatever the odds.
Reserved: Stands at the edge of a group, arms folded, and speaks only when it is worth it.
Light-conscious: Notes every window, lamp and shadow in a room before he settles into it.
Speaking style: Low, measured, grave pronouncements in darkness imagery; few words, raised only to command Dark Shadow.
abilities: Shadow strike: Sends Dark Shadow out from his body to hit, slam or sweep at mid-range; it hits hard in shade and weakly in bright light.
Shadow guard: Puts Dark Shadow between a blow and himself or an ally; strong light or a heavy enough attack breaks it.
Shadow grab: Dark Shadow seizes objects, carries people or pins a target; it lets go when light or force overwhelms it.
Second pair of eyes: Dark Shadow watches and reacts on its own, catching threats from his blind side; in bright light it cowers.
Light management: Reads the lighting of any place and keeps Dark Shadow strong but controllable; in deep darkness it may stop listening.
Fighting style: Stays back, sends Dark Shadow in at angles an opponent cannot watch at once, and keeps it close enough to cover his own ordinary body.
Fumikage Tokoyami.visualDescription: A young man with the head of a black-feathered bird, short feathers swept back into spiky points behind his head, sharp red eyes and a short, pointed yellow beak, on a short, lean build. He wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and dark green trousers. Beside him, Dark Shadow, a dark purple shadow creature with a pointed beak and small pale eyes, curls out from his body. Grave, composed expression.
